Name: Pet Bowl Sprinklers

Description:

[/size]
[b]PetBowlSprinklers[/b] lets you change a few parameters around the Pet Bowl to make your life easier.

This has been created before with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2009/?tab=description]Pet Water Bowl[/url] by Mizzion. I just added a few more features I wanted like the number of days the bowl stays filled.

Fully configurable, so you can make it cheaty, or just less of a pain.

[size=5]Features
[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Enable sprinklers[/b] to fill the boll automatically
[*]Change the number of [b]days the bowl stays filled[/b].
[*]Allow [b]snow to fill the bowl[/b].
[/list]
See configuration for more details.

[size=5]Configuration
[/size]
Here's a list of the configuration options available.

Once run, a [b]config.json [/b]will be created in the mod folder. If you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b], you'll be able to change any of the settings in game!

[size=1]Default:  true[/size]
[size=3]SprinklersFillBowls[/size][b]
[/b][size=2]Should sprinklers be able to fill pet bowls?
[/size]
[size=1]Default:  true[/size]
[size=3]ForceExactBowlTile[/size]
[size=2]Does the sprinkler need to fill the exact bowl tile? [i](The PetBowl building is 2x2 tiles, only one of the tiles is the actual bowl)[/i]
[/size]
[size=1]Default:  1[/size]
[size=3]BowlFilledDuration[/size]
[size=2]How many days should the bowl stay filled?
[/size]
[size=1]Default:  false[/size]
[size=3]SnowFillsBowl[/size]
[size=2]Should snow fill the pet bowl?
[/size]
[size=1]Default:  false[/size]
[size=3]CheatyWatering[/size]
[size=2]Cheater cheater pumpkin eater, bowl will always be filled.[/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].

2. Download this mod and unzip the contents.

3. Place the mod in your Mods folder.

4. Run the game using SMAPI.

Have a nice day!
